functional_evidence.device_routing_evidence: Platform-specific realtime input/output backends are present; runtime device-selection semantics still require target validation.

target_evidence.reason: The package declares Linux but does not explicitly declare Raspberry Pi; the Researcher does not infer Pi support from Linux alone.

strengths: Narrow audio-I/O scope matches the planned platform boundary closely.
Realtime PCM capture and playback are directly relevant to voice-first STT/TTS pipelines.
All six non-Raspberry-Pi required targets are explicitly declared upstream.
Pinned source passed complete static source and supply-chain admission without findings.
risks: Young project with materially lower adoption than flutter-webrtc.
Raspberry Pi is not explicitly supported by the package evidence gathered here.
Exact runtime dependency versions are unresolved, so OSV has not been queried.
Device routing and actual low-latency behavior still need target-specific runtime validation.
